description: This Scala source file defines the KafkaOffsetReaderAdmin class, which uses Kafka's Admin API to read data offsets from Kafka within Spark's Kafka integration module. It manages Kafka offset fetching, retries, and partition offset calculations, and is part of the Kafka 0.10 SQL connector.

classes.name: KafkaOffsetReaderAdmin
classes.description: A class that uses Kafka's Admin API to read offsets, manage retries, and calculate offset ranges for Spark Kafka integration.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Kafka Admin client.

methods.name: fetchPartitionOffsets
methods.description: Fetches offsets for partitions based on the specified range limit and offset type.

methods.name: fetchSpecificOffsets
methods.description: Fetches specific offsets for given partitions, with data loss reporting.

methods.name: fetchSpecificTimestampBasedOffsets
methods.description: Fetches offsets based on timestamps for partitions.

methods.name: fetchGlobalTimestampBasedOffsets
methods.description: Fetches offsets based on a global timestamp.

methods.name: readTimestampOffsets
methods.description: Reads offsets for given timestamp-based offset specifications.

methods.name: fetchSpecificOffsets0
methods.description: Internal method to fetch specific offsets with partition validation and resolution.

methods.name: fetchEarliestOffsets
methods.description: Fetches earliest offsets for assigned partitions.

methods.name: fetchLatestOffsets
methods.description: Fetches latest offsets, with optional validation against known offsets.

methods.name: getOffsetRangesFromUnresolvedOffsets
methods.description: Calculates offset ranges from start and end offset limits, possibly dividing large partitions.

methods.name: partitionsAssignedToAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves assigned partitions and executes a body function with them, with retries.

methods.name: withRetries
methods.description: Executes a body with retries to handle transient failures when fetching offsets.

methods.name: resetAdmin
methods.description: Resets the Admin client to null, forcing reinitialization.
